newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuadorean oil production normal - official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuadorean oil production normal - official.

text.p: Ecuadorean oil output is normal despite the 48-hour general strike which began Wednesday, an official for state oil firm Petroecuador said.
"Petroleum is being produced and pumped normally from Lago Agrio to Balao", a Petroecuador spokesman told Reuters.

But while production staff were working normally, administrative personnel were enjoying a day off granted them to state workers by President Abdal Bucaram to coincide with the general strike, the spokesman said.
But while output is normal, distrubution of fuels within Ecuador has been at a halt since Monday due to a truck drivers strike.
Ecuador produces 380,000 barrels of oil a day, and exported 77 million barrels in the first 11 months of 1996.
